item.title: Durbin urges Section 702 hearing with administration officials
item.description: Senate Judiciary Chairman Charles E. Grassley, left, and ranking member Richard J. Durbin conduct a confirmation hearing on July 30, 2025.

item.title: Lee Hamilton, Indiana Democrat and vice chair of 9/11 Commission, dies at 94
item.description: In his role as vice chair of the 9/11 Commission, former Rep. Lee H. Hamilton was an advocate for streamlining oversight of national security.

item.title: Supreme Court refuses to overturn new California districts
item.description: Voters stand in long lines to cast their ballots in the Proposition 50 special election on redistricting in Garden Grove, Calif., on Tuesday, Nov. 4, 2025.

item.title: As DHS spending debate ramps up anew, a focus on enforcement’s impact
item.description: From left, Sen. Richard Blumenthal, D-Conn.; Rep. Robert Garcia, D-Calif.; Luke Ganger and Brent Ganger arrive for the bicameral public forum on tactics by agents of the Department of Homeland Security on Tuesday. Brent and Luke are brothers of Renee Nicole Good, who was shot and killed by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent in January in Minneapolis.

item.title: Democratic leaders pitch wish list ahead of DHS funding deadline
item.description: Sen. Minority Leader Charles E. Schumer, left, listens to House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries speak during a news conference Wednesday. Also pictured is Rep. Bennie Thompson, the House Homeland Security panel's top Democrat.

item.title: House advances measure to block DC tax code decoupling
item.description: A Washington, D.C., flag in a Capitol Hill neighborhood last fall. Republicans in Congress are moving ahead with an effort to override D.C.’s tax code decoupling.

item.title: Cruz’s satellite licensing bill faces longer delay
item.description: Chair Ted Cruz, R-Texas, and ranking member Maria Cantwell, D-Wash., talk before the start of a Senate Commerce Committee hearing in the Dirksen Senate Office Building on Dec. 17, 2025.

item.title: Hamilton seen, then and now, as embodying ideal of bipartisanship
item.description: Former Rep. Lee H. Hamilton, right, who served as vice chair of the 9/11 commission, is pictured at a 2010 hearing with the panel's former chairman, Thomas H. Kean.

item.title: Georgia’s Barry Loudermilk is latest House Republican to retire
item.description: Georgia Rep. Barry Loudermilk is not seeking reelection this year.
